note: The owner's annexes. Changed only by `apply` of an accepted proposal or by the owner's `require` of a new annex. A requirement names a parameter or a term and never spells out its meaning or its number; this is where the name is defined, so the requirement corpus can be read on its own. A value an actor sets while BEACON is running is not here, nor in a parameter note, which holds its bounds, unit, default and owner, never the current value.
